description: This PHP class 'LanguageDao' provides data access methods for managing 'Language' entities within the OrangeHRM project. It includes functions to save, retrieve, delete, and filter language records from the database, utilizing Doctrine ORM features such as query builders and pagination.

classes.name: LanguageDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object for performing CRUD operations and queries related to 'Language' entities in the system.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves a Language entity to the database.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing language entities given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Fetches a list of languages based on search filter parameters, with pagination.

methods.name: getLanguageListPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginator object to support paginated fetching of languages based on search filters.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Counts the number of languages matching the search criteria.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple language entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language name already exists in the system.
